Every stormy night, he wondered who had written it, and whether the bottle had traveled for years simply to arrive when someone needed it most.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘停泊在雾里的船。高架桥上偶有车灯划过，拖出短暂的光痕；便利店仍亮着，店员伏在柜台后打盹。清洁车缓慢经过，水汽沿着路边流淌。写字楼的窗格大多熄灭，只有几盏灯像未睡的眼睛。远处传来早班地铁的低鸣，风掠过空荡的广场，吹动广告牌边角。天色尚未发白，城市却已在寂静中悄悄准备醒来。","w03":"- Recursion is when a function solves a problem by asking a smaller version of the same problem to solve itself.\n- Like opening nested boxes, you keep opening smaller boxes until you reach the smallest one.\n- Then each box closes back up with its answer, building the final answer step by step."}
